auth.noAccessBody: This console is for Kiorex operations staff (ops_admin or super_admin).

bookings.title: Booking timeline
bookings.hint: Intents, holds, Kiorly responses, events and payments (KXMOP02).
bookings.prompt: Enter a booking ID to see its timeline.

liquidity.title: Marketplace liquidity
liquidity.hint: Last {{days}} days (KXMOP06). Per-cluster split needs Kiorly slot counts.

flags.title: Feature flags
flags.hint: Every flag of every product. OFF stops new actions only — never hides data (KXMOP07–11).
flags.readOnly: Read-only: only super admins can change flags.
flags.twoPersonNote: Money-path flag: turning OFF at global/market scope needs a second super admin to approve.
flags.emergency: Emergency kill (applies now, reviewed within 24 h)
flags.gateHint: The flag becomes effective only after gate evidence is recorded (KXMOP09).
flags.gatesHint: Launch gates are recorded by a human with the approver, date and document. Recording a gate satisfies it for every flag that lists it. The console never records one on its own.

messaging.title: Messaging log
messaging.hint: Email, WhatsApp, SMS and push in one log. Recipients are masked.
messaging.mockNote: Mock mode: nothing leaves the platform. Messages are written to a test inbox; use the controls to simulate delivery states.

fees.title: Fee statements
fees.hint: Kiorex's own marketplace fee per partner. The VAT line is configuration, not a filing.

orders.title: Order monitors
orders.hint: Pharmacy orders and lab bookings. Resubmit a paid order that never reached the partner.
orders.resubmitBody: The paid order is sent to the partner again with the same idempotency key, so it cannot be created twice.

operations.title: Operations
operations.waitlistHint: Looks for free slots matching waiting patients and creates offers. It also runs every minute on its own.

safety.title: Safety console
safety.hint: Home-visit alerts (SAFETY_ALERT_RAISED) must reach on-call within {{s}} s. Acknowledge within 10 minutes or they escalate.
safety.mockNote: Mock on-call delivery: alerts are recorded as delivered, nobody is paged. Connect the on-call provider before launch.
safety.acknowledgeBody: You are taking ownership. The patient and provider are not notified by this action.
safety.escalateBody: Raises the escalation level and pages the next on-call contact.
safety.resolveBody: Close the alert once the situation is handled.

held.title: Held deposits
held.hint: Deposits of unsafe-aborted home visits wait here for a human decision. They are never forfeited automatically.
held.none: No deposits are waiting for review
held.releaseTitle: Release the deposit to the provider?
held.releaseBody: {{amount}} goes to the provider. This is audited and cannot be undone.
held.refundBody: {{amount}} is refunded to the patient. This is audited and cannot be undone.

homeGate.title: Home-visit launch gate
homeGate.hint: Home-enabled providers per launch cluster (KXMOP06). This metric never satisfies a gate: only a human records GHV1 and GHV2.
homeGate.evidenceHint: Counsel memo (GHV1) and CMO safety protocol (GHV2) are recorded by a super admin on the Flags page.

onb.title: Organization onboarding
onb.hint: Import another organization's SQL dump, spreadsheets and patient files into a quarantined batch. The scan proposes the mapping; anything ambiguous becomes a task for a human. Nothing touches live data until a second super admin approves.
onb.newHint: Choose the organization that will receive the data.
onb.uploadHint: SQL dump (.sql), CSV/XLSX, and patient files (PDF, images). Files are scanned in quarantine; SQL is parsed, never executed.
onb.dryNote: {{files}} patient files will be attached · {{merged}} duplicate patients merged · {{warn}} open warnings · {{ignored}} ignored with a reason
onb.cannotCommit: {{n}} blockers must be resolved before this can be committed.
onb.targetMode: Target: {{mode}} (mock keeps everything inside the platform).
onb.requested: Commit requested: a second super admin must approve.
onb.twoPerson: A different super admin must approve this (two-person rule).
onb.commitDone: {{n}} records written. Every record is tagged with this batch so it can be rolled back.

err.REPORT_CHANGED: The data changed after the report; review the dry-run again
err.COMMIT_FAILED_RESUMABLE: Commit interrupted: progress is saved, resume it
err.IGNORE_REASON_REQUIRED: A reason is required to ignore
err.ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED: That action is not allowed here

TABLE_UNCLASSIFIED.title: Unrecognised table
TABLE_UNCLASSIFIED.hint: We could not tell what this table holds. Choose what it contains or ignore it.

MAP_COLUMN_REQUIRED.title: Required column not found
MAP_COLUMN_REQUIRED.hint: Pick the source column for this required field.

CONFIRM_MAPPING.title: Confirm column mapping
CONFIRM_MAPPING.hint: The match is likely but not certain. Choose the right column or ignore to accept it.

MISSING_REQUIRED.title: Required value missing
MISSING_REQUIRED.hint: Type the missing value or skip this row.

INVALID_VALUE.title: Invalid value
INVALID_VALUE.hint: Correct the value, or skip the row if it cannot be fixed.

AMBIGUOUS_DATE.title: Ambiguous date
AMBIGUOUS_DATE.hint: This date reads two ways. Choose the format for the whole import, or type the right date.

ENCODING_PROBLEM.title: Broken characters
ENCODING_PROBLEM.hint: Text looks double-encoded. Repair it to restore the original letters.

DUPLICATE_PATIENT.title: Possible duplicate patients
DUPLICATE_PATIENT.hint: Pick the record to keep and merge, keep both, or skip.

ORPHAN_REFERENCE.title: Record points to a missing patient
ORPHAN_REFERENCE.hint: Assign the right patient or skip the row.

ORPHAN_FILE.title: File matches no patient
ORPHAN_FILE.hint: Assign the file to a patient or skip it.

AMBIGUOUS_FILE.title: File matches several patients
AMBIGUOUS_FILE.hint: Choose the right patient or skip the file.

CONFIRM_FILE_MATCH.title: Confirm file match
CONFIRM_FILE_MATCH.hint: Matched by name or id only. Reassign, skip, or ignore to accept.

FILE_REJECTED.title: File rejected by the scan
FILE_REJECTED.hint: This file was quarantined and will not be imported.

DUPLICATE_FILE.title: Duplicate file
DUPLICATE_FILE.hint: An identical file was uploaded; only one copy is imported.

SQL_UNSAFE_STATEMENTS.title: Non-data statements skipped
SQL_UNSAFE_STATEMENTS.hint: The dump contained commands such as DROP or GRANT. They were never executed.

TRUNCATED_TABLE.title: Table too large
TRUNCATED_TABLE.hint: Only the first rows were read.

policy.title: Market policy
policy.hint: Business defaults per market and organisation. Values marked "Proposed default" were delegated by the founder on 23 Nov 2026 and still need CFO and counsel review; every value can be changed here without a deploy.
policy.depositSummary: {{percent}}% of the consultation fee, capped at {{cap}} {{currency}}. Applies only to providers that enabled deposits and set no amount; the cancel-window forfeiture rule is unchanged.
policy.depositOff: No market default deposit: only explicit provider amounts (or DEPOSIT_DEFAULT_MINOR) apply.

partialMode.MANUAL_REVIEW: Park partial orders for ops review

policy.feeRefunded: Delivery fee refunded when not delivered
policy.released: Fulfilled lines released to the pharmacy
policy.superAdminOnly: Only a super admin can change policies.

alerts.title: Lead alerts
alerts.hint: Who on the Kiorex team is told when a new partner lead arrives. Alerts use the shared notification layer (mock providers for now), respect quiet hours and never repeat for the same lead.
alerts.noRecipients: Nobody has opened the ops console yet. People appear here the first time they sign in.
alerts.noContact: No phone or e-mail on file for this person, so only push can reach them.
alerts.superOnly: Only a super admin can change the global switch and channels. You can change your own row.
alerts.failed: Could not save the alert settings

leads.title: Partner leads
leads.hint: Organisations that pressed Talk to us in a Kiorly product. Contact them within the time they asked for; the status follows their onboarding request automatically.

funnel.title: Onboarding funnel
funnel.hint: Distinct organisations, from privacy-safe counters (organisation id and product only) and real onboarding requests.
funnel.conv: {{prev}} of the previous step, {{all}} of interested

pob.title: Partner onboarding
pob.hint: Standalone clinics, nurses, pharmacies and labs asking to join Kiorex. Automated checks run themselves; steps that need a person are highlighted.
pob.humanBanner: {{n}} step(s) need a person before this partner can go live.

fees.override: Organisation override set on the Policy page

pob.gateNote: Gate evidence is human-only and is never recorded by this wizard.
pob.twoPerson: A different super admin must approve (two-person rule).
pob.rotationPending: The partner submitted new credentials. Apply them after the signed handshake passes.

credentials.title: Credentials
credentials.hint: Partner API address and HMAC client credentials were submitted (secrets are stored encrypted and never shown).

handshake.title: Signed handshake
handshake.hint: Kiorex sends a signed ping to the partner API to prove the credentials work end to end.

sync_dry_run.title: Catalogue / provider dry run
sync_dry_run.hint: Counts what Kiorex would list. Nothing is imported or published.

flags.title: Feature flags and launch gates
flags.hint: Effective flag state per feature. Launch-locked flags need human gate evidence, never automatic.

market_pack.title: Market and pack
market_pack.hint: The market is live and configured.

duplicates.title: Duplicate detection
duplicates.hint: Looks for an existing provider, registration or request for the same organisation.

documents.title: Required documents and terms
documents.hint: The partner product reports licence/credential documents and accepted terms. Only statuses reach Kiorex.

review_documents.title: Review documents
review_documents.hint: Open the partner's licence and credential evidence and confirm it is complete and matches the organisation.

verify_licence.title: Verify licence
verify_licence.hint: Check the licence or registration with the issuing authority and record its reference.

fees.title: Confirm fees
fees.hint: The standard fee policy applies unless a policy override is set for this organisation on the Policy page.

launch_gate.title: Record launch-gate evidence
launch_gate.hint: This feature is launch-locked. Only a human super admin records gate evidence on the Flags page.

approval.title: Approval (two people)
approval.hint: One person prepares and requests; a different super admin approves.

go_live.title: Go live
go_live.hint: Activates credentials, flags and listings. Opens only when every step is green.

code.SIGNED_PING_OK_FLAG_OFF: Signature accepted; the partner feature flag is off
code.SIGNATURE_REJECTED: The partner rejected our signature: check the client key and secret
code.PARTNER_UNREACHABLE: The partner API could not be reached
code.EMPTY_CATALOGUE: The partner catalogue is empty: add priced items first
code.FLAG_OFF_COUNT_UNKNOWN: Count unavailable while the partner flag is off
code.NO_READY_LISTINGS: No listing is ready to go live yet
code.ORG_NOT_RECOGNISED: The clinic system does not recognise this organisation
code.CLINIC_UNREACHABLE: The clinic system could not be reached
code.AWAITING_GATE: A launch gate is waiting for human evidence
code.SIMILAR_NAME: Another request has the same name: check it is not a duplicate
code.ALREADY_LISTED: This organisation already has live listings
code.REGISTRY_DUPLICATE: A partner registration already uses this key or address
code.DOCUMENTS_MISSING: Required documents or terms are missing
code.AWAITING_SECOND_PERSON: Waiting for a second person to approve
code.FLAG_OFF_GLOBAL: The feature is switched off globally
code.FLAG_OFF_MARKET: The feature is switched off for this market
code.FLAG_OFF_ORG: The feature is switched off for this organisation
code.FLAG_DEPENDENCY_OFF: A flag this feature depends on is off

err.GO_LIVE_BLOCKED: Go live is blocked: finish every step first
err.STEPS_OPEN: Finish every check and human step first
err.DOCUMENTS_CHECK_REQUIRED: The documents check must pass first
err.CLINIC_NOTIFY_FAILED: The clinic system could not be told; nothing changed. Retry.
err.ROTATION_HANDSHAKE_FAILED: The new credentials failed the handshake; the current ones stay active
err.LABEL_REQUIRED: Say who this code is for

enrol.title: Enrolment codes
enrol.hint: A partner product needs a one-time code from here to send its first connection request. Give it to the partner over a trusted channel. It is shown once, works once, and expires.
enrol.label: Who is it for
enrol.once: Copy this code now. It will not be shown again.
